missing: A side-by-side of the true all-in-one universal adapters that claim 140W (MOMAX UA16 and peers) with measured 140W into a 16-inch MacBook Pro, how power is split when several ports are in use, which countries' sockets each one fits, and current prices.
why: Macworld, a major reviewer, answers this directly. It names the Satechi 145W travel charger, which has US/UK/EU/AU pins, as its pick for fast-charging the 16-inch Pro, and links to its own review. The MOMAX manual backs up the maker's claim for a universal adapter, but nobody has tested that model. Nearly every other result is unreadable, a 404 or a non-travel 140W charger. A focused page that compares universal adapters with measured 140W could get in, but it would be up against Macworld.
